shots.run: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#full-list li[data-key]'); i++) await wait(250); const real = window.api; const first = document.querySelectorAll('#full-list li[data-key]')[1]; const day = new Date(); day.setDate(day.getDate() - 7); day.setHours(3, 0, 0, 0); const done = { state: 'done', created: day.toISOString(), finished: Date.now() / 1000, apps: ['audiobookshelf', 'bazarr', 'gluetun', 'jellyfin', 'nzbget', 'qbittorrent', 'reelix'], safety: '/srv/media/backups/starboard/starboard-full-' + ((n) => `${n.getFullYear()}-${String(n.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(n.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(n.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}${String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}02`)(new Date(Date.now() - 180000)) + '.starboard' }; window.api = async (path, opts) => { if (path === '/api/backup/full/restore-here') return { status: { ...done, state: 'running', step: 'Starting' } }; const r = await real(path, opts); return path === '/api/backup/full' ? { ...r, restore: done } : r; }; first.querySelector('button').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#restore-full-pw'); i++) await wait(250); document.querySelector('dialog .dialog__foot .btn--danger').closest('form').noValidate = true; document.querySelector('dialog .dialog__foot .btn--danger').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !/Restored the full backup/.test(document.querySelector('#full-restore-state').textContent); i++) await wait(250); window.api = real; document.activeElement?.blur(); document.querySelector('#full-restore-state').scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await wait(300);
shots.alt: Full backups in the folder with example data, with the Restored the full backup message (after step 5) outlined
